claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature_nearest_unoccupied_space_placement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Summoned-creature placement needs a shape more precise than coarse range so authored content can represent nearest-valid-space placement rooted on the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature_catalog_ref_language_override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Catalog-ref summons need a way to express summon-time overrides like shared language comprehension without replacing the full stat block inline.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: creature_control_unspecified_command_range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The control surface currently requires a finite numeric command range even when the rules text defines command obedience but gives no distance limit.
